dataset_title: Green Valleys brown-juice characterization and pilot anaerobic-filter operating profile
source_title: Status of demonstration facilities at AU Foulum and VGN Sötåsen; Green Valleys project meeting, 18 March 2020
authors: Morten Ambye-Jensen (presenter; individual authorship of extracted tables is not stated in the document)
source_location: Presentation sections titled Experimental setup (reactor conditions and duration), Table 1 (pilot operating periods), Brown Juice input/Table 2 (sample characterization), and Conclusions. Web-extracted PDF lines 223-334.
document_type: public project technical presentation / grey literature
license: No explicit reuse license identified; only factual values and short labels transcribed with source attribution.
data_basis: Reported brown-juice sample measurements and study-specific pilot packed-filter operating conditions. Raw and warmed samples remain distinct. Batch BMP is separately labeled from continuous reactor operation.

experimental_context.material: Brown juice from a Green Valleys green-biorefinery demonstration at Aarhus University Foulum, Denmark; crop proportions are not reported in the extracted table.
experimental_context.pilot: Packed anaerobic filter with 5.5 m3 working volume, mesophilic operation reported at 30-32 C, brown juice feed pre-warmed to 55-60 C, semi-continuous operation.
experimental_context.period: 118 days, 4 October 2019 to 29 January 2020; feed stored at ambient temperature reported as -2 to 14 C, average 6 C.
experimental_context.batch_test: The report states ultimate methane potential following 90 days of batch digestion; full batch BMP protocol and uncertainty are not supplied in the extracted passage.

interpretation_and_limits: The reported fresh and warmed brown-juice measurements are sample-specific values, not a controlled before/after experiment with documented replicate uncertainty.
The 409.6 NmL CH4/g VS and 264.2 NmL CH4/g COD values are batch BMP endpoints, not continuous reactor yields.
Period feed load is copied with its printed unit kg/day; the table does not explicitly define the mass basis. Do not infer kg wet feed or use it as a mass-balance flow without confirmation.
Table 1 gives paired printed OLR values (e.g. 1.9 (1.88)); both are retained as text, not represented as an uncertainty range.
No methane fraction, continuous methane yield, COD-removal value by period, energy use, or digestate composition is transcribed from this document.
Cultivated grass/clover Green Valleys brown juice is not GreenHub roadside-grass protein-depleted supernatant; evidence remains reference-only.
normalization: No conversions or inferred values were applied; values and units are transcribed as reported. Period day ranges and paired OLR precision are retained verbatim.
